subject.title: [Feature] Allow configuring Gemini safety settings in OpenClaw

question: Should OpenClaw expose Gemini safety-filter controls, and if so should the permanent contract be a Google-owned provider/model parameter rather than a new generic core provider field?
rationale: This adds a user-facing safety-affecting configuration surface, can relax upstream filtering, and requires intentional decisions about scope, precedence, custom endpoints, warnings, and supported thresholds.

options.title: Approve Google-owned settings
options.body: Add a typed Google-specific provider/model parameter with strict enums, request-level precedence, focused transport injection, documentation, and fresh-install plus upgrade-safe tests.

options.title: Keep request-level only
options.body: Do not add persistent OpenClaw configuration and require users or external provider plugins to supply safety settings per request where supported.

recommendation.title: Approve Google-owned settings
recommendation.body: Add a typed Google-specific provider/model parameter with strict enums, request-level precedence, focused transport injection, documentation, and fresh-install plus upgrade-safe tests.
